Patience Is a Gift
Love that waits without sighing is rare and beautiful. Patience tells your partner, 'You are worth my time.' Today, slow down and let them be human.
Say nothing negative to your partner today. If a frustration rises, breathe and let it pass.
Kindness on Purpose
Kindness rarely happens by accident in a busy home. It is chosen, planned and offered on purpose, even when no one is watching.
Do one unexpected kind thing for your partner today, without being asked and without mentioning it.
Soft Hearts
Grudges grow quietly. Tenderness keeps a heart soft enough to forgive before the sun goes down.
Write down one small hurt you have been holding, then pray over it and let it go.
Love Ties It Together
Many good habits make a marriage strong, but love is the cord that holds them all in place.
Tell your partner three things you genuinely admire about them.
Covering, Not Exposing
Love protects. It doesn't air your partner's weaknesses to friends or family. It covers them with grace.
Speak only well of your partner to others today, and stop yourself from complaining about them.
Gentle Answers
A gentle reply can calm a storm before it starts. A harsh one feeds the wind.
When a tense moment comes, lower your voice and answer softly.
Listen First
We often listen only to reply. Real love listens to understand.
Ask your partner how their day really was, and listen for ten minutes without interrupting or fixing.
Words That Build
Words can be bricks or hammers. Every day we build up or tear down the people closest to us.
Send your partner an encouraging message in the middle of the day.
Them Before Me
Humility puts the other person's needs on the table first. It is quiet and strong.
Let your partner choose today: the meal, the show or the plan, gladly and without comment.
The Fruit of Love
Love, joy and peace aren't forced. They grow when we stay close to God and tend our hearts.
Pray for your partner by name today, asking God to bless them in a specific way.
Don't Go to Bed Angry
Anger itself isn't the enemy, but letting it settle overnight gives it roots.
If anything is unresolved between you, talk gently about it before bed tonight.
Forgive as You Were Forgiven
We have all been forgiven much. That memory makes it easier to forgive the people we love.
Say 'I forgive you' or 'I'm sorry' for something that has been left unsaid.
Honour One Another
Honour treats someone as precious. It is shown in tone, manners and attention.
Thank your partner for something they do that usually goes unnoticed.
Encourager in Chief
Everyone needs a cheerleader. Choose to be the loudest voice of encouragement in your partner's life.
Encourage your partner about a goal, dream or challenge they are facing.
A Cheerful Heart
Laughter is good medicine for a marriage. Joy shared is joy doubled.
Do something together today just for fun. Laugh, play, be silly.
Better Together
Two people facing life side by side are stronger than either one alone.
Work on a chore or task together that usually falls to one of you.
The Third Strand
When God is woven into a relationship, it becomes a cord that does not easily break.
Pray together, even if it is just a short, simple prayer.
Leaving and Cleaving
Love makes your partner your first earthly priority, before friends, hobbies and even family.
Ask your partner if anything in your life makes them feel second place, and listen humbly.
Love That Lasts
Real love isn't swept away by floods of stress or difficulty. It holds on.
Remind your partner of a hard season you got through together, and thank them for staying.
Where You Go
Commitment is a promise to walk the road together, wherever it leads.
Tell your partner, in your own words, that you are in this for life.
No Fear in Love
Love builds a safe place where your partner doesn't need to fear rejection or ridicule.
Ask your partner, 'Is there anything you've been afraid to tell me?' and receive it gently.
We Love Because
Our ability to love begins with God's love for us. We pour out what we first received.
Spend a few minutes thanking God for how He has loved you, then love your partner from that fullness.
Love in Action
Love isn't only words. It shows up with hands, feet and time.
Do a practical act of service your partner will appreciate today.
Hopeful and Patient
Hope looks for the good that is coming. Patience waits for it gracefully.
Share one hope you have for your future together.
Think on Good Things
What we focus on grows. Focus on your partner's good qualities and they will fill your view.
Write a list of ten things you love about your partner and keep it somewhere you'll see it.
The Golden Rule at Home
Treat your partner the way you long to be treated. It's simple, and it changes everything.
Think about how you'd love to be cared for today, then do that for your partner.
What God Joined
A marriage is more than a contract. It is something God Himself has joined.
Look at your wedding photos or a favourite memory together and talk about it.
Love Serves
The greatest love doesn't demand to be served. It looks for ways to serve.
Ask your partner, 'How can I help you today?' and follow through.
A New Commandment
Love one another as you have been loved. It is a high calling, and a gift.
Write your partner a short handwritten love note.
Laying Down Your Life
Most of us won't face a dramatic sacrifice, but we can lay down our pride and preferences daily.
Give up something you wanted to do today in order to bless your partner.
Spurring On
Love stirs up the best in the other person and inspires good works.
Tell your partner about a strength you see in them that they might not see themselves.
Honour the Marriage
Guarding your marriage means protecting your heart, your eyes and your time.
Remove or set aside one thing that competes with your marriage for attention.
Carry Each Other
When one is weary, the other helps carry the load. That is love in real life.
Ask what's weighing on your partner this week and take one burden off their plate.
Accept One Another
Love accepts your partner as they are, not as a project to be fixed.
Let go of one thing you've been trying to change in your partner, and choose acceptance.
Everything in Love
Let love be the tone of every task, every chore and every conversation.
Do every interaction with your partner today with deliberate warmth.
Selfless Love
Love gives itself away, not to gain something, but because the other person is precious.
Plan a small surprise that shows you thought ahead for your partner.
Respect and Love
Every heart longs to be both loved and respected. Offer your partner both, generously.
Tell your partner a specific way you respect them.
One Mind, Tender Hearts
Compassion and courtesy make home a gentle place to land.
Be extra courteous today: please, thank you, and a gentle touch.
Write It on Your Heart
Kindness and faithfulness are meant to be worn close, like a necklace over the heart.
Write down the promises you want to keep to your partner, and share them.
Love Never Fails
Forty days of choosing love has built new habits. Love that is chosen daily does not fail.
Renew your commitment: tell your partner what these 40 days have meant to you, and keep choosing love.
